speaker: The Portcullis
lines: A portcullis seals the inner chamber. High above, its counterweight hangs from a fraying rope that sways in the draught. Cut the rope and the weight drops and the gate rises.

choices.text: Throw your knife at the swaying rope.

minigame.title: The Fraying Rope
minigame.intro: Throw when the rope crosses the mark. Three good hits should do it.
